title: Fantastic experience and to repeat!
text: Fantastic experience! I did a 30-minute half-body Thai massage and came out refreshed. Impeccable technique, perfect pressure and a very careful atmosphere that invites you to relax from the first minute. Without a doubt, a place to return to ✨
author: MissViajes785412

title: 10/10 massage
text:
Flew from mallorca to spend the day in Barcelona, and booked this amazing foot and leg massage. Me and my sister had Pimai and Jirapa, best massage we have ever had you can ask for how hard you want and if it's not to your liking just communicate and let your masseuses know, they will cater to what you need. I will definitely be back and recommend. 

Also location is very easy to find, just a few steps from Casa Mila.  Cleanliness 10/10. Welcome receptionist 10/10. 

Well done ladies on your top service, from start to finish.
